name: Anointing Oil
overview: Scripture reveals that anointing oil holds a sacred purpose, as seen when Jacob poured oil on a stone to mark a holy place, and when God instructed Moses to anoint individuals by pouring oil upon their heads. The detailed formula for this holy anointing oil, given by God through Moses, includes specific spices and olive oil, emphasizing its consecrated nature and the care required in its preparation as a holy ointment.
